title: Commercial Paralegal
description:
Commercial Paralegal - Watford

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Commercial Paralegal with strong contract and document management experience to join a well- known international business in Watford on an initial 6-month contract basis, with a strong likelihood of extension.

As a Commercial Paralegal you will be responsible for reviewing executed contracts, extracting and coding key information and ensuring documents are accurately recoded and uploaded to the relevant systems.

Your skills and experience should include:
- Previous Commercial Paralegal experience
- Strong contract and document management experience
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation
- Experience handling high volumes of documentation

The role is full-time, with the firm looking for someone to work 4 days per week in the Watford office and 1 day from home.

The role is inside IR35, with a day rate of £200-£250 per day ( £52,000-£65,000 annual equivalent).

The ideal start date is October, although November availability may also be considered.

If you are a Commercial Paralegal looking for a new contract opportunity and can commit to 4 days per week in Watford, apply now or get in touch with Alexiane for a confidential conversation.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Watford Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 Permanent: Office-based Monday - Friday

CTR Select is recruiting on behalf of our client for a Marketing Executive to join their team. This is a varied, commercially focused role covering digital marketing, content creation, customer engagement and sales support.

A key focus will be increasing customer adoption and use of the company's B2 B digital ordering portal, alongside delivering campaigns that support sales growth and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop campaigns to increase customer adoption and usage of the digital ordering portal.
- Create targeted email and SMS campaigns to drive engagement and ordering frequency.
- Produce user guides, video tutorials, sales tools, pitch decks and product materials.
- Promote new digital services and portal features to existing customers.
- Create marketing materials for sales meetings, conferences and promotions.
- Manage social media content, blogs, newsletters and website updates.
- Build and distribute targeted email campaigns.
- Monitor website performance and support SEO activity.
- Track digital engagement, sales activity and campaign performance.
- Monitor competitor activity and identify marketing opportunities.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to support business growth.
- Maintain brand assets, templates and marketing materials.

About You

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a marketing role, preferably within a B2 B or commercial environment.
- Experience with email marketing, CMS and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design tools.
- Good understanding of digital marketing, social media and SEO.
- Strong Excel, organisational and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive, commercially aware and flexible approach.
- An understanding of AI tools and their application within marketing.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, creative and commercially minded marketer looking for a varied role where they can make a real impact on customer engagement and business growth.

If this Marketing Executive role is of interest to you, please click apply or contact Marie Spratley in our Egham office.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Watford
Salary: 25000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
Working hours: Flexible start between 8:00am-9:00am, finishing between 4:00pm-5:00pm with a 30-minute lunchbreak
Contract: Permanent
Start: Immediate

About the Opportunity

We are delighted to be recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join a well-established organisation that is currently going through an exciting period of growth.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing team at an important time for the business. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will become an integral part of the customer service team, providing a high-quality and professional service to clients throughout the full customer journey - from onboarding and quotations through to reporting, invoicing and managing day-to-day communications.

You will play an important role in ensuring customers receive an excellent level of service, working closely with internal departments and external clients to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and effectively.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and expanding organisation where you can make a genuine contribution to the customer experience, develop your skills and build a long-term career within a supportive team environment.

If you are organised, customer-focused and thrive in a busy environment, we would love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you will be responsible for delivering an excellent customer experience while working closely with internal teams and external clients.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the team with the administration associated with onboarding new clients and the continued delivery of excellent customer service.
- Managing and responding to incoming client communications via email and telephone in a timely and professional manner.
- Acting as a first point of contact for client queries and resolving issues wherever possible.
- Escalating and coordinating queries with the appropriate internal teams where required.
- Inputting and maintaining accurate customer information within LIMS and other internal systems.
- Liaising with customers regarding sample paperwork, COCs and purchase orders.
- Preparing accurate, fit-for-purpose quotations within the approved authority level.
- Coordinating logistical queries and arrangements where required.
- Managing subcontract laboratory services when necessary.
- Liaising with analytical teams to ensure customer projects are delivered successfully.
- Coordinating the delivery of customer receipts, reports and invoices.
- Providing accurate client information and updates to the wider team.
- Working with the SCSA and Customer Service Manager as part of a continual improvement process.
- Building and maintaining strong, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Processing media orders and developing knowledge of sampling techniques.
- Completing result uploads, calculations and accurate data entry.
- Checking data entry and calculations completed outside of the LIMS system.
- Supporting the wider customer service function as required.

These duties are not exhaustive and should not be interpreted as a complete definition of the role.

About You

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, organised and confident communicating with a wide range of people. You will be comfortable working in a busy environment, managing competing priorities and maintaining a high level of accuracy.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service role
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment - desirable.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and confident telephone manner.
- Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
- The ability to manage your own workload effectively.
- A collaborative, "one team" approach.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Strong numerical and accurate data-entry skills.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office 365, Excel and Word.
- The ability and willingness to learn and use various in-house systems and processes.
- A positive and adaptable approach to change.
- Flexibility and the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

Company Benefits

In addition to joining a well-established and growing organisation, the successful candidate will receive the following benefits:
- Annual Leave: 22 days' holiday per year, plus bank holidays.
- Healthcare: Healthcare provision.
- Death in Service: Life cover equivalent to four times your annual salary.
- Company Pension: Access to a company pension scheme.
- Free on-site parking

Interested?

If you are looking for a permanent Customer Service Advisor opportunity with a growing organisation and believe you have the skills and experience required, we would love to hear from you.

Please get in touch to find out more and discuss the opportunity in further detail.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Document Controller
description:
Document Controller - Watford

Location: Watford, Hertfordshire
Position: Document Controller
Sector: Main Contractor / Construction
Salary: Competitive + Package

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Document Controller to join a leading main contractor on a construction project based in Watford.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established contractor with a strong pipeline of projects across the UK.

The successful candidate will have previous experience working on-site within the construction industry, ideally for a main contractor, and will be confident managing project documentation while supporting the wider site team.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain project documentation, ensuring accurate filing, tracking and distribution.
- Control drawings, technical submissions, RFIs and other construction documentation.
- Ensure all project information is kept up to date and compliant with company procedures.
- Liaise with site teams, subcontractors, consultants and project management.
- Manage document revisions and ensure the latest information is available to relevant stakeholders.
- Support the site team with general administration and reporting.
- Maintain document registers and assist with project handover documentation.

Requirements
- Previous experience as a Document Controller within the construction industry.
- Essential: Experience working on a live construction site.
- Ideally previous experience working for a main contractor.
- Good knowledge of document management systems such as Aconex, Viewpoint, Asite or similar.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident communicating with site teams, subcontractors and senior management.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to work with a leading, established main contractor.
- Long-term career development and progression opportunities.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Supportive and professional project team.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Document Controller with construction site experience and are interested in an opportunity in Watford, please apply or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator

Location: Watford

Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-time, office-based Monday to Friday.

CTR Select is recruiting for an HR Coordinator to join a busy and supportive HR team. Reporting to the Head of HR, you will provide a broad range of HR support across the business, working closely with managers, senior leaders and employees.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day HR advice and support to managers and employees.
- Support recruitment, selection and onboarding processes.
- Coordinate inductions and mandatory training for new starters.
- Advise and coach managers on employee relations, performance, disciplinary and grievance matters.
- Support reward and recognition initiatives.
- Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HR systems.
- Ensure HR policies and procedures remain compliant with UK employment legislation.
- Produce HR reports and metrics to support senior management decision-making.
- Keep up to date with employment law, HR best practice and industry developments.

About You

We are looking for a proactive and people-focused HR professional with:
- Previous experience in a generalist HR, HR Coordinator or HR Advisory role.
- Good knowledge of UK employment legislation.
- Experience supporting recruitment and employee relations.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to coach, influence and build relationships at all levels.
- Experience with HRIS and HR reporting.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
- A professional, confidential and diplomatic approach.

If this HR Coordinator role is of interest to you, please click apply or contact Marie Spratley in our Egham office.

title: Operations Co-Ordinator
description:
We are currently recruiting for an exciting opportunity as an Operations Co-Ordinator to join a growing and dynamic team based in Watford, Hertfordshire. This role offers the chance to play a key part in a thriving international business, supporting the full lifecycle of customer order fulfilment, from initial enquiries and order updates through to delivery coordination and issue resolution. The client is renowned for delivering end-to-end procurement, supply chain management, logistics and financial solutions to businesses operating across the mining and energy industries, supported by a global network of suppliers and service providers.

You will work closely with internal departments and external partners to ensure customers receive a seamless and professional service throughout the order process. Acting as a key point of contact for customers, you will provide regular updates, manage expectations and coordinate with the wider Operations, Accounts and Warehouse teams to ensure goods are delivered on time and in full. You will also liaise with third-party logistics providers to arrange transport, packaging, inspections and other services in line with customer requirements. This role is ideal for someone who is customer-focused, proactive and keen to develop within a busy international operations environment.

You will be responsible for monitoring customer orders, providing accurate updates, preparing invoices and supporting documentation, and coordinating domestic and international logistics. A key part of the role will involve investigating and resolving discrepancies raised by customers or internal teams, maintaining accurate order records and escalating issues where necessary to ensure a swift resolution. Going above and beyond for customers will be essential, so excellent communication skills, attention to detail and a professional, solutions-focused approach are paramount. Previous experience in customer service, order processing, account management or operations administration would be beneficial, while knowledge of logistics or CRM systems would be an advantage.

This is a full-time, office-based position in Watford, Hertfordshire, working Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm. The role offers a salary of 26,000 - 29,000 per annum, dependent on experience, plus a generous monthly bonus scheme following successful completion of probation. Additional benefits include 20 days' annual leave, increasing with service to 25 days, five personal days, a wellness day, your birthday off, group life assurance, a pension scheme, subsidised on-site meals, paid sick days and regular office socials. If this role sounds like something of interest, we would love to hear from you!

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Watford Office-Based Monday-Friday

38,000 Basic Salary ( 50,000 OTE) 25 Days Holiday + 8 Bank Holidays Free On-Site Parking

Ready to turn opportunities into success?

Are you a proactive, commercially minded sales professional who loves winning new business, building relationships and seeing the results of your hard work reflected in your earnings?

We're looking for an ambitious Sales Executive to join a growing business with big plans for expansion. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys picking up the phone, opening doors with new customers, and turning prospects into long-term, profitable relationships.

You'll play a key role in developing new business across Ireland, working closely with a field-based Business Development Manager to unlock untapped opportunities, reactivate lapsed accounts and build a loyal customer base.

With investment already made in local stock and a next-day delivery service available to Irish customers, you'll have a compelling proposition to take to market, and plenty of opportunity to make your mark!

What will you be doing?

This is a hands-on, new-business sales role where your energy, organisation, and ability to build rapport will make all the difference.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Winning new business: Contact new prospects and re-engage lapsed customers, taking opportunities from the first conversation through to their first order and beyond.
- Building relationships: Develop trust with customers, understand their needs and turn one-off orders into long-term trading relationships.
- Proactive prospecting: Make outbound calls and send targeted emails, follow up quotations, and identify opportunities to generate sales.
- Managing incoming leads: Qualify website enquiries, campaign responses and event leads, ensuring promising opportunities are followed up quickly.
- Supporting field sales: Work closely with the Business Development Manager, arranging customer visits, preparing relevant information and following up afterwards.
- Developing the Irish market: Promote the available product range, make the most of local stock availability and provide customers with accurate pricing and delivery information.
- Managing your pipeline: Keep customer information, quotations, and opportunities up to date within the CRM system

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is motivated by targets, enjoys speaking to people and takes pride in turning opportunities into results.

You'll ideally be:
- Confident and persuasive, with excellent communication skills.
- Proactive and resilient, comfortable picking up the phone and initiating conversations.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to ask the right questions and understand customer requirements.
- Organised and reliable, with strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.
- Motivated by achieving targets and earning performance-related rewards.
- A team player who communicates well, shares information and takes ownership of their work.
- Comfortable using CRM systems and managing a busy sales pipeline.

Experience in B2 B sales, trade sales or business development would be a real advantage. Knowledge of construction, access equipment or utilities sectors would also be beneficial, although a strong sales attitude and the desire to succeed are just as important.

Benefits
- 38,000 basic salary
- 50,000 OTE with performance-related bonus and company profit share
- 25 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- A friendly, supportive working environment where teamwork matters
- A Monday-to-Friday working pattern, based in the Watford office
- The opportunity to take ownership of a sales territory and make a genuine commercial impact
- The chance to develop your skills and progress within an ambitious, growth-focused business

Ready to take the next step?

If you're hungry for success, enjoy the challenge of winning new customers and want to join a friendly team where you can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your sales career!
